MATTER_BRIDGE.NAME: Matter Bridge
MATTER_BRIDGE.DESCRIPTION: Exposes Automatica controls (switches, dimmers, blinds) to Matter controllers such as Apple Home, Google Home, Amazon Alexa, SmartThings or Home Assistant

PAIRING_CODE.NAME: Pairing code
PAIRING_CODE.DESCRIPTION: Manual pairing code to enter in the Matter controller app

QR_CODE.NAME: QR code payload
QR_CODE.DESCRIPTION: Content of the Matter QR code (MT:...), can be rendered by any QR code generator

COMMISSIONED.NAME: Paired
COMMISSIONED.DESCRIPTION: True when at least one Matter controller (fabric) is paired

FABRICS.NAME: Paired controllers
FABRICS.DESCRIPTION: Number of Matter fabrics the bridge belongs to

OPEN_COMMISSIONING_WINDOW.NAME: Allow pairing (15 min)
OPEN_COMMISSIONING_WINDOW.DESCRIPTION: Opens the commissioning window for 15 minutes so that another controller can be paired with the pairing code

RESET_PAIRINGS.NAME: Remove all pairings
RESET_PAIRINGS.DESCRIPTION: Removes the bridge from all Matter controllers and makes it pairable again

STATE.NAME: Matter state
STATE.DESCRIPTION: Internal persistent state of the Matter node

ON_OFF_LIGHT.NAME: On/Off light
ON_OFF_LIGHT.DESCRIPTION: Light that can be switched on and off

COLOR_TEMPERATURE_LIGHT.NAME: Tunable white light
COLOR_TEMPERATURE_LIGHT.DESCRIPTION: Light with brightness and color temperature

EXTENDED_COLOR_LIGHT.NAME: Color light
EXTENDED_COLOR_LIGHT.DESCRIPTION: RGB light with brightness, color and optional color temperature

WINDOW_COVERING.NAME: Blind / shutter
WINDOW_COVERING.DESCRIPTION: Window covering with position (0 % = open, 100 % = closed) and optional up, down and stop

AIR_QUALITY_SENSOR.NAME: Air quality sensor
AIR_QUALITY_SENSOR.DESCRIPTION: Air quality with optional CO2, particulate matter, VOC, temperature and humidity

THERMOSTAT_HEAT_COOL.NAME: Thermostat (heating & cooling)
THERMOSTAT_HEAT_COOL.DESCRIPTION: Room thermostat for heating and cooling

ON_OFF.NAME: On/Off
ON_OFF.DESCRIPTION: Switching state, set by Matter controllers and by Automatica

POSITION.NAME: Position
POSITION.DESCRIPTION: Position in percent (0 = open, 100 = closed); the written value is the current position, the read value the requested target

CLOSE.NAME: Close
CLOSE.DESCRIPTION: Close command from a Matter controller

STOP.NAME: Stop
STOP.DESCRIPTION: Stop command from a Matter controller

AIR_QUALITY.NAME: Air quality
AIR_QUALITY.DESCRIPTION: 0 unknown, 1 good, 2 fair, 3 moderate, 4 poor, 5 very poor, 6 extremely poor
